withdrawn.claim: jj op-store GC called with SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH preserves nothing by recency.
withdrawn.raised_in: Arm C, as one supporting leg of C4C-05.
withdrawn.withdrawn_because: remove_file_if_not_new keeps a file when its mtime is newer than keep_newer, so UNIX_EPOCH removes nothing. deepseek41 caught it against jj lib/src/simple_op_store.rs and the adjudication bundle amended Arm C's records.
withdrawn.effect: Record 9 stands on its lock-coverage leg alone. No commit message, acceptance criterion, ledger record or receipt in this wave cites the withdrawn claim.
